• Music service for nursing home

projects.title: BookBay Online Bookstore
projects.description:
• Design and implement a dynamic web project based on Model View Controller and weekly sprints
• JSP pages, servlets and JDBC used for form submissions and other website functionalities
• Create web pages with the help of Bootstrap API
• Git used to coordinate team efforts
• Document user stories, use cases, domain class diagrams, and object relational mappings
